en: Psalms 35
By David.

p.src: 1  Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

en: Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
u.src: 1  Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

p.src: 2  Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

ja: り、 私を助けるために
en: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
u.src: 2  Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

p.src: 3  Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

ja: たちを遮ってください。
en: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
u.src: 3  Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

p.src: 4  Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

ja: たちが失望し、不名誉を
たちが引き返させられ、恥をかきますように。
en: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
u.src: 4  Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

p.src: 5  Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.

ja: のもみ殻のようになり、
en: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.
u.src: 5  Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.

p.src: 6  Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.

en: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.
u.src: 6  Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.

p.src: 7  For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

en: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
u.src: 7  For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

p.src: 8  Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

ja: に襲いかかりますように。
らえますように。 彼がその破
en: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
u.src: 8  Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

p.src: 9  My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

ja: ぶだろう。 私の魂は主の
en: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
u.src: 9  My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

p.src: 10  All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

ja: よ、誰があなたに似ているだろうか。 あなたは、
en: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
u.src: 10  All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

p.src: 11  Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

ja: らない事柄について私を
en: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
u.src: 11  Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

p.src: 12  They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

en: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
u.src: 12  They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

p.src: 13  But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

ja: 気のとき、私の衣は荒布であった。 私は
en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.
u.src: 13  But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

p.src: 14  I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

ja: であるかのようにふるまった。 私は自分の
en: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
u.src: 14  I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

p.src: 15  But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

ja: しかし、私が逆境にあるとき、
まったが、私はそれを知らなかった。 彼らは私を
en: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.
u.src: 15  But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

p.src: 16  Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

ja: 会で不敬虔にあざける
en: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
u.src: 16  Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

p.src: 17  Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

ja: ておられるのか。 私の
から、 私の尊い命を
en: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.
u.src: 17  Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

p.src: 18  I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

en: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.
u.src: 18  I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

p.src: 19  Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

ja: たちが、不当に私のことで
ばないようにしてください。
せしないようにしてください。
en: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.
u.src: 19  Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

p.src: 20  For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

en: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
u.src: 20  For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

p.src: 21  Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

ja: けた。 彼らは言った。「あはは。私たちの
en: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
u.src: 21  Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

p.src: 22  You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

ja: っていないでください。
en: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
u.src: 22  You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

p.src: 23  Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

ja: まし、立ち上がって私を弁護してください。 私の主よ、
のために争ってください。
en: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
u.src: 23  Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

p.src: 24  Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

ja: の正しさを明らかにしてください。
らないようにしてください。
en: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
u.src: 24  Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

p.src: 25  Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

ja: で、「あはは。これこそ私たちが
わないようにしてください。 彼らに、「私たちは
en: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
u.src: 25  Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

p.src: 26  Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

ja: に逆らって自分を大きくする
と不名誉を着せられますように。
en: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.
u.src: 26  Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

p.src: 27  Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

ja: しみますように。 まことに、
えず、「主はほめたたえられますように。
はそのしもべの繁栄を
ばれる」と言いますように。
en: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”
u.src: 27  Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

p.src: 28  My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

ja: り、 あなたをほめたたえるだろう。
en: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
u.src: 28  My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
